en.title: AI-generated complaints are overwhelming UK public bodies
en.summary: UK public bodies, local authorities, and MPs' offices are struggling with a massive surge in AI-generated complaints and letters, a phenomenon dubbed 'AI clog'. While AI helps citizens write formal and lengthy requests easily, it creates a heavy workload for human employees who must read and respond to them.
en.full_summary:
The Rise of AI Clog
Chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude have made it easy for ordinary people to generate formal complaints, legal challenges, and freedom of information requests. However, this has led to a massive influx of correspondence received by UK public bodies, businesses, and courts, severely straining their limited resources.
Impact on Public Services
Local authorities report that complaints have grown from an average of two pages to up to 200 pages, often filled with legal jargon, irrelevant case law from other jurisdictions, and occasional AI hallucinations. Employees must still review these manually, leading to exhaustion and delays, while diverting funds away from essential public services.
Potential Solutions
Experts suggest that organizations might eventually need to deploy their own AI tools to filter out the automated flood, or implement stricter rules such as word limits and submission fees. Meanwhile, some offices have started ignoring automated mass-email campaigns to focus on genuine constituents.

zh.title: AI生成的投诉信正在压垮英国公共机构
zh.summary: 英国的公共机构、地方政府和议员办公室正面临着AI生成的投诉信激增的困境，这种现象被称为“AI堵塞”。虽然AI帮普通人轻松写出了长篇大论的正式信件，但也给需要人工审核和回复的工作人员带来了沉重的工作负担。
zh.full_summary:
AI堵塞的出现
像ChatGPT和Claude这样的聊天机器人让普通人能够轻松生成正式投诉、法律挑战和信息自由请求。然而，这也导致英国公共机构、企业和法院收到的信件数量暴增，严重挤压了本就有限的资源。
对公共服务的影响
地方政府报告称，投诉信的平均长度从以前的两页激增到了现在的最多两百页，里面常常充斥着法律术语、来自其他司法管辖区的无关判例以及AI的胡言乱语。工作人员必须人工审核这些信件，导致身心俱疲和处理延迟，并分散了本应用於基础公共服务的资金。
潜在的应对方案
专家建议，机构最终可能需要部署自己的AI工具来过滤这股自动化洪流，或者实施更严格的规则，比如字数限制和提交费用。同时，一些办公室已经开始忽略自动化的群体邮件，以便专注于真正需要帮助的选民。

en.title: Capital cools on AI world models as investors get pickier
en.summary: The hype around world models is fading fast, with venture capitalists tightening their purse strings and making it much harder for early-stage startups to raise money. While the market is cooling down from its summer peak, top-tier talents from elite universities are still managing to secure massive funding. This shift shows that investors are no longer buying into vague concepts and now demand real technology and actual progress.
en.full_summary:
Background
Earlier this year, world models became one of the hottest topics in AI, drawing massive attention and capital from eager investors trying not to miss the next big thing. However, after major industry events and a reality check from secondary markets, the initial excitement quickly evaporated.
Key Details
Many early investments were driven by FOMO, leading to inflated valuations. As public market benchmarks faced adjustments and funding timelines slowed down, investors started scrutinizing startups much more carefully. Despite the overall slowdown, elite founders with strong academic backgrounds in top institutions still managed to pull in hundreds of millions.
Impact
The market shift marks the end of an era where companies could easily raise funds just by slapping a buzzword on a pitch deck. The industry is now entering a phase that demands rigorous validation, pushing startups to prove their technical capabilities and practical applications in the physical world.

zh.title: 资本正在降温世界模型，投资人开始精挑细选
zh.summary: 曾经火爆的世界模型赛道迎来了急转直下，VC资本收紧了钱包，创业公司拿钱变得越来越难。虽然整个市场从夏天的狂热中迅速降温，但那些来自顶级名校的明星团队依然能顺利拿到大笔资金。这说明投资人不再为单纯的概念买单，而是开始看重硬核技术和实际落地进展。
zh.full_summary:
背景与变化
今年上半年，世界模型凭着巨大的想象空间吸引了无数热钱，各大机构生怕错过风口疯狂出手。但在经历了一系列行业展会和资本市场的冷静期后，这股热潮迅速降温，投资人的耐心变得有限。
关键细节
过去几个月里，由于早期机构出手过猛加上二级市场参照物的影响，投资人开始精打细算。虽然整体融资事件减少，但以清北硕博为代表的顶级人才依然能凭借扎实的研究背景和技术储备拿到数亿元融资。
行业影响
这场洗牌意味着靠概念和想象力融资的日子已经过去。对于整个赛道来说，虚空造概念的时代正在结束，创业团队必须拿出真东西来向市场证明自己的商业和技术价值。

en.title: GitHub's Next Scaling Challenge: Rebuilding the Software Stack for Agent Workloads
en.summary: In a recent discussion following his GitHub Universe keynote, Microsoft CoreAI EVP Jay Parikh outlined how agent workloads are fundamentally changing GitHub's scaling requirements. With the platform hosting 225 million developers and 34.3 billion commits, Parikh discussed model orchestration through Copilot Fusion, cross-device AI sessions, and the necessity of measuring AI spending against actual business outcomes. These insights point toward an industry-wide transition where infrastructure must adapt from human-centric to agent-centric software development.
en.full_summary:
Rebuilding for Agent Scale

As GitHub scales to accommodate 225 million developers and tens of billions of commits, the platform's primary infrastructure challenge is shifting from human-driven activity to automated agent workloads. Jay Parikh, EVP of CoreAI at Microsoft, notes that this requires a fundamental redesign of the software-development stack, transitioning development infrastructure toward handling high-frequency, agent-generated actions.
Model Orchestration and Copilot Fusion

The conversation highlights Copilot Fusion's approach to balancing the quality-cost frontier through intelligent model routing. Rather than relying on a single model, the system determines when a model drafts code independently, when a judge reviews it, and when multiple models critique the output. This orchestration layer acts as a harness designed to optimize both execution quality and token expenditure.
Economic and Architectural Shifts

Beyond model routing, Parikh addresses the evolving economic framework of AI development, arguing that organizations should measure AI spending directly against completed work and business outcomes rather than raw token consumption. Additionally, architectural changes—such as moving GitHub's infrastructure to Azure and handling cross-device sessions that persist across phones, desktops, and VS Code—reflect how developer tooling is adapting to continuous, agent-driven workflows.

zh.title: GitHub的下一次规模挑战：为智能体工作负载重构软件技术栈
zh.summary: 在GitHub Universe主题演讲后的一次访谈中，微软CoreAI执行副总裁Jay Parikh阐述了智能体工作负载如何从根本上改变GitHub的规模需求。面对平台拥有的2.25亿开发者和343亿次提交，Parikh探讨了通过Copilot Fusion进行模型编排、跨设备AI会话，以及根据实际商业成果衡量AI支出的必要性。这些观点指向了一个全行业正在发生的转变：基础设施必须从以人类为中心向以智能体为中心的软件开发转型。
zh.full_summary:
为智能体规模进行重建

随着GitHub规模扩大到容纳2.25亿开发者和数百亿次提交，该平台面临的基础设施主要挑战正从人类驱动的活动转向自动化的智能体工作负载。微软CoreAI执行副总裁Jay Parikh指出，这需要对软件开发技术栈进行根本性的重新设计，使开发基础设施能够处理高频率的、智能体生成的各种操作。
模型编排与 Copilot Fusion

访谈重点介绍了Copilot Fusion通过智能模型路由平衡质量与成本边界的方法。系统没有依赖单一模型，而是能够自主判断何时由单个模型独立编写代码、何时由评审模型进行审查，以及何时由多个模型共同对输出进行批判。这种编排层充当了一个旨在优化执行质量和Token消耗的技术支架。
经济与架构转型

除了模型路由之外，Parikh还探讨了AI开发的演进经济框架，认为企业应当将AI支出直接与完成的工作和商业成果挂钩，而不是单纯看Token消耗量。此外，诸如将GitHub基础设施迁移至Azure，以及支持跨手机、桌面和VS Code持续运行的跨设备会话等架构变化，反映出开发者工具正在适应持续的、由智能体驱动的工作流。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: Tech giants GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pooled their expertise to outline 15 design patterns for building reliable AI agent systems. These patterns help developers manage complex tasks, ensure data accuracy, and make AI systems safer and more practical for real-world business applications.
en.full_summary:
Background
As AI agents move beyond simple chat interfaces into complex, multi-step workflows, ensuring reliability and structural control has become a major challenge for developers.
Key Details
GitHub, Google, and Siemens have released a comprehensive guide detailing 15 design patterns for agentic systems. These include data validation schemas, error-handling loops, human-in-the-loop verification, and advanced context management using tools like Model Context Protocol (MCP). The patterns address common failure points such as infinite loops, formatting errors, and unverified data modifications.
Impact
These standardized patterns provide a practical roadmap for companies looking to deploy AI agents securely. By establishing clear boundaries and verification steps, they minimize the risk of costly errors and pave the way for autonomous AI systems in software development and enterprise operations.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合整理AIagent设计的15个经典模式
zh.summary: 科技巨头GitHub、谷歌和西门子联合梳理出了AIagent开发的 15个设计模式。这些套路能帮开发者更好地指挥AI处理复杂任务、保证 数据准确性，让AI在实际工作中变得更靠谱、更好用。
zh.full_summary:
背景介绍
随着AIagent从简单的聊天工具变成能干复杂活儿的帮手，怎么让它们更靠谱、不出错成了开发者最头疼的问题。
核心细节
GitHub、谷歌和西门子这次把各自的实战经验总结成了15个设计模式。这里面涵盖了数据格式规范、出错自动重试、人工把关验证，以及利用MCP等协议来管理上下文的各种实用妙招。它们专门用来对付AI容易陷入死循环、瞎编数据或者改错代码的毛病。
行业影响
这套标准化的套路给想用AIagent的企业提供了一份操作指南。通过给AI定规矩、加卡点，能大幅减少翻车风险，让AI在软件开发和企业日常运营里真正派上用场。

en.title: Midterm Elections Spell Trouble for Elon Musk and AI Data Centers
en.summary: The recent midterm elections resulted in significant setbacks for tech companies, as voters and newly elected officials strongly pushed back against AI data centers. Elon Musk's massive political donations failed to yield expected benefits while his businesses remain in a shifting political landscape. Consequently, public backlash and tighter regulations are forcing AI giants like OpenAI to rethink their secretive policies and try to rebrand their infrastructure projects.
en.full_summary:
Political Backlash
The recent midterm elections saw a wave of pushback against data centers across the United States. Voters rejected ballot measures that would have fast-tracked infrastructure, while electing politicians who campaigned on restricting these massive facilities. Industry figures noted that Elon Musk's heavy spending on Republican campaigns ultimately brought little return, especially as his businesses are now anchored in a state that has shifted politically.
Changing Tactics
For years, big tech companies relied on aggressive tactics, including strict non-disclosure agreements with local officials, to push through power-hungry and water-intensive projects in sensitive areas. This secretive approach triggered a strong grassroots backlash from voters across the political spectrum. In response to the mounting political and regulatory pressure, companies like OpenAI are starting to change course, releasing new policy blueprints that drop secrecy requirements and attempt to rebrand data centers as friendlier-sounding 'compute campuses.'
Future Challenges
Despite these attempted PR makeovers, critics remain skeptical that rebranding will solve the underlying friction. At the same time, tech giants face a financial squeeze, as Walluring investors grow increasingly weary of the astronomical costs associated with building out massive AI infrastructure. Navigating stricter local regulations while managing skeptical investors will likely pose a major hurdle for the industry moving forward.

zh.title: 美国中期选举结果出炉，埃隆·马斯克和AI数据中心要头疼了
zh.summary: 美国近期中期选举给科技行业泼了一盆冷水，选民和新上台的官员纷纷对AI数据中心说不。埃隆·马斯克砸了巨资押注却竹篮打水一场空，其企业所在的州政治风向也发生了大转变。面对汹涌的民意和即将到来的监管压力，大厂们开始坐立难安，像OpenAI这样的公司甚至已经开始修改其保密政策，试图给这些大型基建项目换个好听的名字来挽回民心。
zh.full_summary:
政治风向转变
美国最近的中期选举给科技巨头敲响了警钟，各地选民和新当选的官员开始联手抵制AI数据中心。多项旨在限制或叫停这类高耗能设施的投票获得通过，主张收紧政策的候选人也成功上台。与此同时，业内人士指出，埃隆·马斯克此前砸下巨资支持共和党，但最终几乎没有捞到什么实质好处，其旗下公司还身处政治风向急转直下的环境中。
策略被迫调整
长期以来，科技公司在推进项目时往往采用遮遮掩掩的态度，甚至要求地方官员签署严苛的保密协议，在水资源紧缺的地区强行推进耗电耗水大户。这种傲慢的做法激怒了基层民众。面对汹涌的民意压力，OpenAI等企业终于坐不住了，开始主动发布所谓的计算园区政策蓝图，承诺放弃保密要求，并试图把“数据中心”包装成听起来更温和的“计算园区”。
未来面临双重夹击
尽管科技公司试图通过改名换姓来改善公众形象，但业内人士普遍认为这种公关手段很难真正化解矛盾。雪上加霜的是，华尔街对AI基础设施建设的狂热态度正在降温，投资者对天文数字般的烧钱行为越来越感到不安。未来几年，科技巨头不仅要应对更加严苛的政策监管，还要安抚失去耐心的投资人，日子恐怕不会太轻松。

en.title: Why a former Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs co-founded a defense AI startup
en.summary: Former Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs General Paul Selva explains how manual logistics during Hurricane Katrina inspired him to co-found DEFCON AI. The startup builds AI software designed to help military planners make faster decisions in logistics and mobility, addressing the fragmentation of critical operational data.
en.full_summary:
The Origins of DEFCON AI

Former Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Paul Selva, co-founded DEFCON AI after a 39-year career in the United States Air Force. The venture is rooted in a pivotal realization during Hurricane Katrina in 2005. While watching the disaster unfold from Iraq, Selva observed that critical information needed by his team was scattered across disparate systems, and data aggregation remained entirely manual.
Modernizing Military Logistics with AI

DEFCON AI focuses on building artificial intelligence software, modeling, simulation, and analysis toolsets specifically tailored for military transportation and logistics. According to the company's background, the software aims to provide resilient optimization of complex systems, empowering military planners to anticipate, assess, and mitigate network disruptions in dynamically changing operational environments.

zh.title: 前美军参谋长联席会议副主席为何联合创立国防AI初创公司
zh.summary: 前美军参谋长联席会议副主席保罗·塞尔瓦（Paul Selva）将军解释了卡特里娜飓风期间的手动后勤工作如何启发他联合创立了DEFCON AI。该公司致力于构建AI软件，旨在帮助军事规划人员在后勤和机动性方面做出更快决策，以解决关键作战数据碎片化的问题。
zh.full_summary:
DEFCON AI的起源

美军参谋长联席会议前副主席保罗·塞尔瓦将军在完成美国空军39年的军旅生涯后，联合创立了DEFCON AI。这一创业举措根源于2005年卡特里娜飓风期间的一个关键领悟。当时在伊拉克目睹灾情发展的塞尔瓦发现，其团队所需的关键信息散落在不同的系统中，数据汇总完全依赖人工。
用AI现代化军事后勤

DEFCON AI专注于构建专为军事运输和后勤量身定制的人工智能软件、建模、仿真和分析工具集。根据公司背景介绍，该软件旨在对复杂系统进行弹性优化，赋能军事规划人员在动态变化的操作环境中预测、评估和缓解网络中断问题。

en.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
en.summary: I tested the new AI-powered tool from NYT Cooking on ingredient swaps, recipe scaling, and equipment changes. While it saved my weeknight dinner by smartly adapting a chicken recipe to what was in my fridge, it also nearly caused a baking disaster by giving me the wrong butter amount for a modified recipe. Overall, it acts as a useful sous chef that streamlines the traditional comment section advice, though you still need to keep a close eye on it.
en.full_summary:
The NYT Cooking app recently introduced an AI assistant trained on user comments and its extensive recipe database, designed to help users customize recipes on the fly. During a weeknight test, the author asked the AI to adapt a chicken and rice recipe based on a random assortment of fridge ingredients. The AI successfully generated a modified version with alternative ingredients and adjusted cooking instructions, ensuring the dish remained tasty.

However, baking proved to be a trickier challenge. When the author converted a Bundt cake recipe into muffins and halved the ingredients, a subsequent mix-up between the original and modified versions in the app led to a near-mistake with the butter quantity. Despite these minor hiccups, the tool offers a streamlined alternative to reading hundreds of reader comments for substitution tips, functioning as a practical assistant while still requiring human oversight.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪应用的AI助手：能帮你搞定鸡肉晚饭，但差点毁了蛋糕
zh.summary: 我测试了纽约时报烹饪应用全新的AI工具，体验了替换食材、调整分量和更换烤具。虽然它通过灵活修改鸡肉食谱拯救了我的晚饭，但由于给错了黄油分量，也差点在烘焙时酿成大祸。总的来说，它就像一个靠谱的副厨，能帮你快速省去翻看评论区的麻烦，不过你还是得盯紧它。
zh.full_summary:
纽约时报烹饪应用最近推出了一款基于用户评论和庞大食谱库训练的AI助手，旨在帮助用户随时调整食谱。在一次工作日的测试中，作者让AI根据冰箱里仅有的随机食材来修改一道鸡肉饭食谱。AI成功生成了一个新版本，给出了替代食材和调整后的烹饪说明，做出来的味道也很不错。

不过，烘焙则要棘手得多。当作者把一款环形蛋糕食谱改成松饼并将分量减半时，由于在应用中混淆了原版和AI修改版，差点在黄油用量上出了差错。尽管存在这些小波折，但与翻阅数百条评论来寻找替代建议相比，这个工具确实更加省时高效，它能充当一个实用的厨房帮手，不过人类主厨依然得亲自把关。

en.title: Tech Stocks Plunge as AI Bubble Fears and Regulations Hit Wall Street
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst drop since April 2025, wiping out over $2.5 trillion in market value as worries about an AI speculative bubble resurfaced. Driven by the midterm election results, investors are waking up to the physical constraints and rising regulatory risks facing data centers, signaling a much-needed reality check for the booming industry.
en.full_summary:
The Market Shock
On Thursday, November 5, the tech-heavy Nasdaq plunged by 5.5%, marking its worst session since April 2025 and erasing more than $2.5 trillion in market capitalization in just 24 hours. This sudden drop followed record highs in October, driven by stratospheric valuations and an unshakeable enthusiasm for artificial intelligence. However, the Democratic Party's sweeping victory in the midterm elections on November 3 acted as a major catalyst, heightening fears of stricter government regulations on AI development and data center expansion.
Physical Constraints and Profitability
The market correction highlights a growing disconnect between financial speculation and physical reality. The massive electricity and water consumption required by AI data centers has sparked local opposition, with voters backing initiatives to restrict such facilities. Furthermore, the industry faces mounting questions regarding investment profitability, as astronomical funding relied on assumptions of effortless future revenues while infrastructure obstacles multiplied.
Economic Implications
Beyond Wall Street, the downturn poses broader economic risks. AI has recently become a core engine of U.S. economic growth, supported by hundreds of billions in investments and a stock-driven wealth effect. A lasting loss of confidence could trigger a vicious cycle of delayed projects and reduced activity, potentially turning AI from an economic driver into a vulnerability.

zh.title: 科技股遭遇暴跌，AI泡沫破裂担忧与监管压力打击华尔街
zh.summary: 纳斯达克指数创下2025年4月以来的最大单日跌幅，市值蒸发超过2.5万亿美元，引发了市场对人工智能泡沫破裂的担忧。受中期选举结果影响，投资者开始清醒地认识到数据中心面临的物理限制与监管风险，这对狂热的行业来说是一次及时的现实敲打。
zh.full_summary:
市场震荡
11月5日星期四，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数暴跌5.5%，创下2025年4月以来的最糟糕表现，在短短24小时内蒸发了超过2.5万亿美元的市值。此前，在对人工智能的狂热情绪推动下，股市在10月份创下历史新高。然而，11月3日民主党在中期选举中的大胜成为了导火索，加剧了市场对AI发展和数据中心扩张将面临更严格政府监管的担忧。
现实阻碍与盈利性质疑
这次市场回调突显了金融投机与现实世界之间的脱节。AI数据中心巨大的耗电量和耗水量引发了当地民众的反对，许多选民支持限制这类设施的建设。此外，随着基础设施建设障碍重重，行业面临着越来越多的投资回报性质疑，此前的巨额融资大多建立在未来收入会源源不断的乐观假设之上。
经济影响
这场危机不仅局限于华尔街，还对美国整体经济构成了潜在风险。近期，AI已成为美国经济增长的主要引擎之一，依靠数千亿美元的投资和股市繁荣支撑。如果市场信心持续受挫，可能会引发项目延迟和经济活动减缓的恶性循环，甚至让AI从经济增长的发动机变成薄弱环节。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI inference costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), allowing users to divide a single physical GPU into multiple independent partitions. This solves the long-standing problem of wasted computing power when a model doesn't need an entire accelerator, enabling companies to deploy multiple models on one instance securely and cost-effectively.
en.full_summary:
Deploying AI models to GPUs has traditionally forced a rigid choice: either pay for a whole accelerator that a smaller model cannot fully utilize, or struggle with complex self-managed Kubernetes stacks. With native GPU partitioning on SageMaker AI, users can now slice accelerators like the A100 or H100 into independent partitions with hardware-enforced isolation.

AWS tests show that running a model on a partitioned newer GPU can actually be faster and cheaper than using a whole older GPU. For example, a partitioned H100 slice outperformed a whole A100 while significantly lowering the cost per million tokens. This capability makes it much easier to run a portfolio of models on the same hardware without performance interference.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现已支持多实例 GPU，大幅降低AI推理成本
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理服务现在支持英伟达多实例 GPU (MIG) 技术，允许用户把一块物理显卡拆分成多个独立的分区。这解决了过去“小模型用不完整张显卡、白白浪费钱”的老大难问题，让企业能够在一台机器上安全部署多个模型，大大节省了成本。
zh.full_summary:
过去在云端部署AI模型时，大家常常面临两难：要么为小模型买单整张大显卡造成严重浪费，要么只能自己去搭建和维护复杂的 Kubernetes 集群。现在，亚马逊 SageMaker AI 直接内置了 GPU 分区功能，用户可以把 A100 或 H100 这样的高端显卡切成多块独立区域，并且由硬件层直接保证隔离性。

AWS 的实测表明，用较新显卡的一个分区去跑模型，性能和性价比甚至比整张旧显卡还要好。比如，一块切分后的 H100 片段在处理大并发任务时，速度更快且每百万token的成本更低。这项功能让企业能把各种大小模型混搭在同一台机器上，既不影响性能，又大幅提高了显卡利用率。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open source wireless tools, including Aerial and Sionna, have seen a tenfold growth in global developer adoption over the past year. Researchers worldwide are using these platforms to build AI-native 6G networks, enabling robots to react faster, improving signal reception in tough conditions, and saving power.
en.full_summary:
Over the past year, NVIDIA's open source 5G and 6G tools, such as Aerial and Sionna, have surpassed one million downloads and are used by over 8,000 research and academic institutions globally. These tools connect simulation and AI training with real-world wireless experiments, helping researchers tackle key challenges in future networks.

At King's College London, researchers used NVIDIA Sionna to develop goal-oriented semantic communications for robots. Instead of sending full images, robots transmit compact object descriptions, reducing task completion time by up to 52.6% in dynamic environments. Meanwhile, SoftBank and ETH Zurich demonstrated that AI-powered neural receivers can significantly improve signal reception and throughput under interference.

Energy management and simulation speed are also major areas of improvement. Researchers at the University of Leeds used a portable 5G setup powered by NVIDIA to predict network demand, cutting base station power consumption by 45.6%. Additionally, the Centre Tecnològic de Telecomunicacions de Catalunya used GPU acceleration to reduce network simulation runtimes from hours to minutes, speeding up the path from innovation to real-world deployment.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具如何帮助研究人员打造下一代 6G 网络
zh.summary: 英伟达的无线开源工具在过去一年里大受欢迎，全球开发者采用率增长了十倍。世界各地的研究人员正利用这些平台来打造人工智能原生的 6G 网络，让机器人反应更快、在恶劣环境下更好地接收信号并节省电量。
zh.full_summary:
在过去的一年里，英伟达的 5G 和 6G 开源工具（如 Aerial 和 Sionna）下载量突破了百万大关，被全球 8000 多家研究和学术机构广泛使用。这些工具将仿真测试与人工智能训练同真实世界的无线实验连接起来，帮助研究人员攻克未来网络建设中的关键难题。

在伦敦国王学院，研究人员利用英伟达 Sionna 开发了面向机器人的目标导向语义通信技术。机器人不再传输完整的图像，而是只发送紧凑的物体描述，在动态环境中的任务完成时间缩短了最高 52.6%。与此同时，软银和苏黎世联邦理工学院的研究表明，人工智能神经接收机能够显著改善干扰环境下的信号接收和数据吞吐量。

能源管理和仿真速度也是主要的改进方向。利兹大学的研究人员利用英伟达技术预测网络需求，将基站能耗降低了 45.6%。此外，加泰罗尼亚电信技术中心利用图形处理器加速，将网络仿真运行时间从几小时缩短到十几分钟，从而加快了从创新构想到现实部署的进程。

en.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
en.summary: Video-Coder introduces a code-driven video generation agent that writes and executes code to build dynamic 3D scenes, trained via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with execution and video rewards.
en.full_summary: Video-Coder addresses the challenge of precise spatial structure, motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition in video generation by introducing a code-driven agent. The agent autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that guides downstream video generators. To enable this paradigm, the authors designed a dedicated data pipeline, curated two datasets (Video-Coder-SFT-6k and Video-Coder-RL-2k), and developed the Video-Coder Harness, an interactive environment for code execution, 3D rendering, and feedback. The model is trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by harness-native reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback and an annealing strategy that balances execution and video rewards. Experiments indicate significant performance improvements on benchmarks such as PhyGenBench and VBench-2.0. The code, data, and models are fully open-sourced, though the paper is currently a preprint.

zh.title: Video-Coder：用强化智能体编码赋能视频生成
zh.summary: Video-Coder 引入了一种代码驱动的视频 generation 智能体，通过编写和执行代码构建动态 3D 场景，并采用监督微调以及结合执行和视频奖励的强化学习进行训练。
zh.full_summary: Video-Coder 旨在解决视频生成中精确空间结构、运动动力学和可控场景组合的难题，提出了一种代码驱动的智能体。该智能体能够自主编写和执行代码以构建动态 3D 场景（草稿视频），从而为下游视频生成器提供结构和运动信号。为支持这一范式，作者设计了专门的数据管道，整理了两个数据集（Video-Coder-SFT-6k 和 Video-Coder-RL-2k），并开发了集成代码执行、3D 渲染和反馈的交互式环境 Video-Coder Harness。模型首先进行监督微调，随后采用结合双重奖励反馈（执行奖励与视频奖励）及退火训练策略的强化学习进行训练。实验表明，该模型在 PhyGenBench 和 VBench-2.0 等基准测试中显著提升了性能。尽管目前该论文为预印本，但作者已完全开源了代码、数据和模型。

en.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
en.summary: This preprint investigates Weight-Space Programming (WSP), an alternative to gradient-based adaptation where reasoning agents directly inspect and modify neural network parameters. Testing across seven benchmarks and two model scales, the authors show that modifying very few parameters can yield large accuracy gains, though editing reliability and cross-task transfer remain uneven.
en.full_summary: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) allows reasoning agents to directly inspect and modify neural network parameters instead of relying on standard gradient-based adaptation. This preprint systematically investigates WSP using 16 editing trajectories across seven benchmarks and two model scales (Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-9B). The findings reveal three main insights: first, WSP can achieve substantial performance gains via highly localized interventions—such as improving accuracy by 29.45 percentage points on MATH-500 by modifying only 1,023 parameters. Second, WSP exhibits promising yet uneven cross-task generalization, where a math-edited checkpoint transfers well to some benchmarks (e.g., SciBench and IFEval) but leaves others unchanged. Third, effective editing remains challenging and inconsistent, with substantial variation across trajectories and several attempts retaining original weights due to unreliable validation. The paper provides open-source code and highlights the fundamental challenges of intervention discovery, reliability, and cross-task transfer in parameter-level editing.

zh.title: 探索权重空间编程：能力、泛化与局限性
zh.summary: 这篇预印本研究了权重空间编程（WSP），这是一种替代基于梯度的模型微调的方法，允许推理智能体直接检查和修改神经网络参数。作者在七个基准测试和两个模型规模上进行评估，表明修改极少数参数就能带来显著的准确率提升，但编辑的可靠性和跨任务迁移能力仍然很不均衡。
zh.full_summary: 权重空间编程（WSP）允许推理智能体直接检查和修改神经网络参数，而不是依赖标准的基于梯度的自适应方法。该预印本通过16条编辑轨迹、7个基准测试和两个模型规模（Qwen3.5-0.8B和Qwen3.5-9B）系统地研究了WSP。研究结果揭示了三个主要见解：首先，WSP可以通过高度局部的干预实现显著的性能提升，例如仅修改1,023个参数就在MATH-500上将准确率提高了29.45个百分点。其次，WSP表现出有前景但不均衡的跨任务泛化能力，经数学任务编辑的检查点可以迁移到其他基准（如SciBench和IFEval），但对某些任务无效。第三，有效的编辑仍然具有挑战性和不一致性，不同轨迹的结果差异很大，由于验证不可靠，部分尝试最终保留了原始权重。该论文开源了代码，并指出了参数级编辑在干预发现、可靠性和跨任务迁移方面面临的基本挑战。

en.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings 15-second videos and lower prices
en.summary: Google has launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, its updated AI video generation model that now supports 15-second clips and costs 30% less than the previous version. The new model offers better reference consistency, conversational editing, and is now generally available across developer and enterprise platforms.
en.full_summary:
Google is rolling out Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, bringing significant upgrades to its AI video generation tool. The new version supports native 15-second video creation, up from 10 seconds, and allows users to specify durations in one-second increments.
Pricing and Workflow
Google has dropped the price by 30%, bringing it down to $0.07 per second for 720p video. The updated workflow lets users draft quickly at lower resolutions, fix specific details through follow-up edits, and upscale the final results to 1080p or 4K.
Key Features and Availability
The model introduces enhanced reference adherence, allowing characters, products, and styles to stay consistent across different camera angles. Users can also perform conversational editing turn by turn, altering backgrounds or lighting without starting from scratch. The tool is now generally available through the Gemini API, Google Cloud, and consumer apps like Google Vids and the Gemini app.

zh.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，视频生成时间延长且降价三成
zh.summary: 谷歌推出了全新的 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 视频生成模型，不仅视频时长延长到了 15秒，价格也比上一代 便宜了三成。这个新模型支持多轮对话修改画面，还能更好地保持人物和风格的一致性，目前已经面向开发者和企业全面开放。
zh.full_summary:
谷歌正式推出了 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 视频生成模型，在视频时长、价格和编辑功能上都迎来了全面升级。新版本支持生成最长 15秒 的原生视频，用户可以按秒精确控制时长。
降价与高效工作流
谷歌将该模型的定价下调了 30%，720p 视频的费用降至每秒 0.07 美元。全新的工作流允许用户先用低分辨率快速生成草稿，通过局部修改调整细节，最后再把满意的作品放大到高清或4K分辨率。
核心功能与全面开放
新模型大幅提升了对参考图的还原能力，无论是人物面部、服装还是品牌颜色，在不同的镜头转换中都能保持高度一致。此外，用户还可以通过 对话交流 的方式直接修改视频背景或光照，而不用重新生成整个画面。目前该功能已在谷歌的 API、云平台以及多款消费者应用中全面上线。

en.title: Google Research introduces AI system to detect hypertension using smartwatches
en.summary: Google Research has developed an artificial intelligence system that uses everyday smartwatch sensors to passively detect signs of high blood pressure without needing traditional cuff calibration. Published in Nature, the research shows the tool achieves accuracy levels comparable to clinical standards, potentially helping bridge the global awareness gap for a condition that affects over one billion people.
en.full_summary:
Background
High blood pressure is a widespread health issue that often goes unnoticed because it rarely shows obvious symptoms. Traditional wearable blood pressure trackers usually require regular arm cuff calibration to measure relative changes, which limits their usefulness as independent screening tools.
Technology
Google Research scientists created a multimodal AI system named AI-PPG-ACC-HTN. It analyzes sensor data from consumer smartwatches over multiple days, using a deep convolutional neural network trained through self-supervised contrastive learning. By combining these passive physiological signatures with the user's height, the system calculates a continuous hypertension probability score.
Impact
Validated against 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring in a clinical study, the smartwatch system showed high specificity and predictive value. While not meant to replace standard medical devices, this technology could offer a scalable screening tool to catch the condition early and encourage people to seek professional medical care.

zh.title: 谷歌研究推出利用智能手表检测高血压的AI系统
zh.summary: 谷歌研究团队开发了一个人工智能系统，能够利用普通的智能手表传感器来默默检测高血压迹象，而且完全不需要传统血压计那样繁琐的校准。这项发表在《自然》杂志上的研究表明，该工具的准确率已经能够媲美临床标准，有望帮数以亿计的高血压患者更早发现健康隐患。
zh.full_summary:
背景
高血压被称为无声杀手，全球有超过十亿人受其困扰，但由于平时很难察觉出明显症状，许多人根本不知道自己患病。虽然市面上有一些智能穿戴设备可以追踪血压变化，但它们通常需要经常用传统的臂带进行校准，无法作为独立的筛查工具。
技术
谷歌研究团队开发了一套名为AI-PPG-ACC-HTN的多模态人工智能系统。它不需要任何袖带校准，而是通过收集智能手表在多天里记录的传感器数据，利用深度学习模型来捕捉血管和心脏功能的细微特征，最终结合身高计算出持续的高血压风险概率。
影响
在一项临床研究中，该系统与黄金标准的24小时动态血压监测进行了对比，表现出了很高的准确度。虽然它无法完全替代去医院的专业诊断，但这项技术未来有望成为一种方便的日常筛查工具，在疾病造成严重危害之前提醒人们及时去医院检查。

en.title: Oumi updates its AI engineer to support full agents
en.summary: Oumi has updated its automated AI engineer called FAiE to support building and testing complete AI agents rather than just single models. The new release also brings cost tracking and advanced training methods.
en.full_summary: Oumi's November product release expands its FAiE (Frontier AI Engineer) system to handle the full lifecycle of AI agents, moving beyond simple model optimization. Key updates include agent development and evaluation tools, Bring Your Own Harness (BYOH) to connect existing frameworks without rebuilding, advanced post-training methods like DPO and GRPO, multi-stage training workflows, and detailed cost transparency. These features aim to automate complex engineering tasks such as data synthesis, performance evaluation, and iterative model improvement.

zh.title: Oumi平台升级：用AI帮你造AI智能体
zh.summary: Oumi平台升级了它的自动化AI工程师，不仅能优化单个模型，还能直接帮你开发和测试完整的AI智能体。这次更新还带来了更高级的训练方法和更清楚的费用统计。
zh.full_summary: Oumi在11月的更新中，将其自动化AI工程师FAiE的能力从单个模型扩展到了完整的AI智能体。这次新功能包括智能体开发与评估、允许开发者直接接入已有框架的BYOH功能、更高级的DPO和GRPO模型训练方式，以及能看清每一笔开支的费用透明化功能。通过这些工具，企业可以把数据合成、性能评估和模型迭代等繁琐的工程活交给AI自动完成，不用再手动瞎折腾。

en.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
en.summary: SplatAnything introduces Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm) to canonicalize scene-level Gaussian spacing, resolving ambiguous supervision and improving feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting across varying scene scales and viewpoints.
en.full_summary: SplatAnything addresses a fundamental limitation in existing feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods: although radial distances are often normalized, the actual spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers varies widely across diverse scene scales and camera layouts, causing systematic inconsistencies in scale targets and ambiguous supervision. To fix this, the authors propose Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which standardizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to act as a consistent spatial reference. Evaluated across a newly established benchmark covering diverse datasets, sparse inputs, and extrapolated viewpoints, SplatAnything demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, especially under severe scale and viewpoint variations. As a preprint, the method offers practical utility for fields like autonomous driving and AR/VR, though independent replication and full ablation details should be verified from the complete paper text.

zh.title: SplatAnything：面向任意场景前馈3D高斯 splatting 的高斯间距归一化方法
zh.summary: SplatAnything 提出了高斯间距归一化（GSNorm）技术，用于将场景级的高斯间距规范化，从而解决监督信号模糊的问题，并提升在不同场景规模和视角下的前馈 3D 高斯泼溅性能。
zh.full_summary: SplatAnything 针对现有前馈 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法中的一个核心局限展开研究：尽管常规方法会规范化径向距离，但相邻高斯中心之间的实际间距在不同场景规模和相机布局下变化显著，导致尺度目标系统性失调以及监督信号模糊。为此，作者提出了高斯间距归一化（GSNorm）方法，通过将高斯间距的场景级稳健统计量进行规范化，提供一致的空间参考。研究团队建立了一个涵盖多数据集、稀疏输入和外推视角的系统性基准进行评估。实验表明，SplatAnything 实现了最先进的性能，在剧烈尺度和视角变化下尤为突出。作为一篇预印本论文，该方法在自动驾驶和 AR/VR 等领域具有实际应用潜力，但其完整消融实验和独立复现情况仍需结合完整论文进一步确认。

en.title: Introducing Inkling 2 Small: A Powerful New Open-Weight AI Model
en.summary: Inkling 2 Small is a new Mixture-of-Experts AI model with 594B total parameters, offering massive upgrades in coding, vision, and reasoning. Initially available with closed weights on Tinker, its full Apache 2.0 weights will be released next week following safety checks.
en.full_summary:
Inkling 2 Small represents a major leap forward, featuring 594B total parameters and 17B active parameters, with robust support for image inputs and variable execution effort. In terms of training, the model underwent extensive pre-training across multiple data phases, followed by a massive 9-day reinforcement learning run using thousands of GPUs. It excels significantly in long-horizon autonomous tasks, such as agentic coding, automated research, and complex financial analysis, often rivaling or outperforming existing open and closed-weight competitors on benchmark tests.

Security and alignment were core priorities during its development. The team implemented rigorous multi-layer monitoring and specialized alignment techniques to curb undesirable behaviors like reward hacking and covert actions, ensuring safer autonomous operations. While initial weights are restricted for safety testing, the complete release under an Apache 2.0 license aims to provide the developer community with a state-of-the-art open foundation model.

zh.title: Inkling 2 Small 正式发布：一款强大的全新开源权重 AI 模型
zh.summary: Inkling 2 Small 是一款拥有 5940 亿参数的混合专家模型，在编程、视觉和推理能力上实现了全面升级。它目前在 Tinker 平台上以闭源权重上线，经安全测试后将于下周开放 Apache 2.0 开源权重。
zh.full_summary:
Inkling 2 Small 代表了一次重大的技术跃升，它拥有总计 5940 亿参数（激活参数 170 亿），并全面支持图像输入和可变计算强度。在训练方面，该模型经历了多阶段的海量数据预训练，并进行了为期 9 天、使用数千块 GPU 的大规模强化学习。它在自主编程、自动研究和复杂财务分析等长期自主任务中表现卓越，在多项基准测试中足以媲美甚至超越现有的开源及闭源竞争对手。

安全与对齐是其开发过程中的重中之重。团队引入了严格的多层监控和专门的对齐技术，以遏制奖励作弊和隐蔽行动等不良行为，从而确保更安全的自主运行。尽管初始权重因安全测试而暂未完全公开，但其随后将在 Apache 2.0 许可证下完整开源，为开发者社群提供顶尖的开源基座模型。

en.title: Apple Researchers Train Neural Networks to Speed Up RAG Retrieval
en.summary: Researchers at Apple have developed a new method to speed up the core search process behind recommendation systems and RAG. Instead of treating all search queries the same, they use small neural networks trained on typical user questions to predict and route queries to the right data much faster. This approach significantly cuts down search latency while keeping high accuracy, offering a smarter way to handle massive databases.
en.full_summary:
In a paper presented at ICML 2026, Apple researchers introduced a technique called amortized maximum inner product search (MIPS) to improve retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and search systems. Traditional systems often rely on geometric approximations, such as clustering keys and comparing queries to cluster centroids, which can lead to errors because queries (short user questions) and keys (long curated texts) differ significantly. To solve this, the researchers train small neural networks offline—specifically SupportNet and KeyNet—using supervised learning on typical query distributions.

SupportNet learns the mathematical support function of data clusters to route queries more accurately, helping the system find the right partition up to 1.9 times faster than traditional centroid routing. Meanwhile, KeyNet acts as a query rewriter that transforms incoming questions directly into predicted key vectors, allowing existing index systems to retrieve true keys up to 11 times fewer database scans. This method effectively trades a one-time training cost for significantly faster inference, demonstrating how knowing the query distribution in advance can dramatically optimize computational resources in production machine learning systems.

zh.title: 苹果研究人员训练神经网络，让 RAG 检索速度大增
zh.summary: 苹果研究人员开发了一种新方法，用来给推荐系统和 RAG 背后的核心搜索过程加速。他们没有把所有搜索请求一视同仁，而是用小型神经网络提前学习用户的常见提问，从而更准、更快地把请求引导到正确的数据上。这种方法在保持高准确率的同时，大幅降低了搜索延迟，为处理海量数据库提供了一种更聪明的方式。
zh.full_summary:
在 2026 年 ICML 会议上，苹果研究人员提出了一种名为摊销最大内积搜索（MIPS）的新技术，用来改进 RAG 和搜索系统。传统的搜索系统通常依赖几何近似方法，比如对数据进行聚类并将查询与聚类中心进行比较；但由于用户的查询通常是简短的问题，而数据库里的键是长篇的文本，两者的差异会导致这种传统方法经常出错。为了解决这个问题，研究人员离线训练了小型神经网络（SupportNet 和 KeyNet），让它们通过监督学习来适应常见的查询分布。

其中，SupportNet 能够学习数据簇的数学支撑函数，从而更准确地引导查询，其找到正确数据分区速度比传统方法快近 2 倍。而 KeyNet 则充当“查询重写器”，直接将输入的提问转换为预测的键向量，让现有的索引系统在检索时能够少扫描多达 11 倍的数据库。这种方法通过牺牲一次性的训练成本换取了极快的推理速度，展示了在生产环境中提前摸清用户提问规律如何能大幅优化计算资源。

en.title: Mistral Updates Studio to Help Companies Build AI Agents and Apps
en.summary: Mistral has updated its enterprise platform, Mistral Studio, alongside its new AI model, Mistral Large 4. The update gives businesses the tools to build, run, and manage AI agents, workflows, and applications securely. Companies can deploy these tools in the cloud or on their own private servers while keeping full control over data.
en.full_summary:
Mistral has announced major upgrades to Mistral Studio, its enterprise AI platform, alongside the release of its new flagship model, Mistral Large 4 (affectionately nicknamed Le Chonk). The updated Studio platform introduces managed agents, automated workflows, and enterprise application building tools designed to move corporate AI projects out of the pilot phase and into active production.
Core Features
The new Studio platform brings together agents, workflows, and apps on a shared infrastructure. Agents can investigate complex tasks and take actions, workflows coordinate multi-step business processes with human approvals, and custom apps give employees direct access to these AI systems. Developers can build locally using familiar coding agents and deploy directly to Studio with a single command.
Enterprise Security and Control
A major focus of the release is data sovereignty and security. Enterprises can deploy Mistral Studio in their own cloud environments, private VPCs, or entirely on-premises. The platform provides OpenTelemetry traces for full observability, allowing companies to audit model calls, tool usage, and approval steps to ensure safe and reliable operations.

en.title: Atlas World Model Gets Real-Time Exploration with Frameboy
en.summary: Researchers have released Frameboy, a new demo that lets users explore 3D worlds generated by the Atlas world model in real-time at up to 15 fps. By streaming frames from cloud GPUs straight to the browser, the tool removes the frustrating wait times of traditional AI video generation. This speed lets creators explore and iterate instantly, completely changing how people interact with generative 3D spaces.
en.full_summary:
Background
Two months ago, the team introduced Atlas, an autoregressive world model capable of generating frames one at a time with precise camera control. However, generating videos previously required waiting tens of seconds or minutes, forcing users to be very cautious with their inputs and severely limiting creative freedom.
Details and Features
The newly released Frameboy demo streams optimized Atlas-generated frames from cloud GPUs directly to web browsers at up to 15 fps. Additionally, the team integrated this capability into Viewfinder, a web app that allows users to build custom scenes frame-by-frame using a single input image or text caption, and then explore them live.
Impact
By dropping latency and making generation nearly instantaneous, the cost of a bad idea becomes zero. Users no longer perceive a distinct act of waiting for generation, turning what used to be a tedious trial-and-error process into an intuitive exploration experience that paves the way for future generative 3D renderers.

en.title: Cerebras CEO Pushes Back Against Short Seller Report on Chip Lifespan
en.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman published a detailed response to a short seller report claiming that their massive wafer-scale AI chips wear out in two years. Feldman explained that they solved the extreme thermal expansion challenges years ago through steady temperature controls and flexible electrical connections. Backed by TSMC's manufacturing qualifications and real-world data showing an ultra-low decommissioning rate, he argued that the chips will easily last decades and only be retired when newer, more efficient technology comes along.
en.full_summary:
Overcoming Thermal Challenges
Building wafer-scale computer processors has historically been considered nearly impossible because silicon and circuit boards expand at different rates when heated, threatening to crack the hardware. Cerebras spent a decade solving this mechanical hurdle. Their patented assembly avoids abrupt temperature changes by smoothing current swings, circulating chilled water evenly, and using flexible electrical connections that move naturally as temperatures fluctuate.
Debunking the Lifespan Claims
The short seller report relied on the Arrhenius equation and GPU economic lifespan comparisons to argue a two-year hardware failure rate. However, Feldman pointed out that the report used incorrect inputs for the equation. TSMC qualifies Cerebras wafers for ten years of continuous operation at high temperatures, while real-world operational temperatures average below 65 degrees Celsius. This indicates a physical lifespan measured in decades rather than years, mirroring standard silicon behavior where chips become economically obsolete before they physically wear out.

zh.title: Cerebras CEO回击做空报告：芯片寿命远超预期，不是两年坏
zh.summary: Cerebras公司CEO安德鲁·费尔德曼公开发文，强力回击了一份声称其巨型AI芯片两年就会磨损报废的做空报告。他解释说，公司通过专利的温度控制和柔性连接设计，多年前就克服了晶圆级芯片的散热难题。结合代工厂的质量认证和不到百分之零点五的实际淘汰率，他用数据证明这些芯片能用几十个年头，未来退役纯粹是因为有了性价比更高的更新换代产品，而不是被热坏的。
zh.full_summary:
攻克散热与机械难题
在半导体行业，制造整片晶圆大小的巨型处理器一度被认为是不可能的任务，因为硅片和电路板在冷热交替时膨胀率不同，极易导致连接断裂。Cerebras花费了十年时间来攻克这一难关。他们通过专利设计，让电流变化平缓、用冷水均匀降温，并采用可以自由伸缩的柔性电路连接，成功解决了热胀冷缩带来的应力破坏。
驳斥做空报告的寿命论断
做空报告此前依据阿伦尼乌斯公式和GPU的经济寿命，推测Cerebras芯片仅有两年的寿命。但费尔德曼指出该报告弄错了公式参数。台积电的数据表明，该芯片能在高温下持续运行十年，而实际运行温度更低，这意味着它们的物理寿命长达数十年。和普通芯片一样，它们最终是因为有了更好用的替代品而“退休”，而不是被热坏的。

en.title: LlamaParse Now Supports Flexible Deployments in Any Environment
en.summary: Document AI tool LlamaParse can now be deployed wherever your data lives, ranging from a fully managed SaaS to private VPCs and air-gapped data centers. Teams can choose whether to manage their own GPUs or let LlamaIndex handle inference, matching strict security and compliance needs.

Deployment Options

Inference Flexibility

en.title: Cohere Embed 5 and Rerank 5 Are Now Live on OpenRouter
en.summary: Cohere's powerful retrieval models, Embed 5 and Rerank 5, are now available on OpenRouter. Developers can combine them using a single API key to build a cost-effective, high-performance RAG pipeline in just a few lines of Python code.
en.full_summary:
How It Works
Building a modern RAG pipeline usually requires juggling multiple tools, but OpenRouter now hosts both of Cohere's latest retrieval powerhouses under one roof. The setup uses Embed 5 Pro to build a searchable document index at the highest quality, while Embed 5 Fast handles real-time queries with minimal latency, leveraging a shared embedding space to preserve retrieval accuracy.
Precision Reranking
After fetching initial candidates via vector similarity, Rerank 5 steps in to score and filter the results. Because its relevance scores are fully calibrated across different queries and domains, developers can rely on a single threshold to cleanly strip out weak context before it ever reaches the language model.
Practical Benefits
This unified approach simplifies development and cuts down on infrastructure overhead. Every component, from vector generation to the final chat response, runs through the same API, making it simple to swap models or scale up with enterprise documents.

zh.title: Cohere 的 Embed 5 和 Rerank 5 模型现已上线 OpenRouter
zh.summary: Cohere 强大的检索模型 Embed 5 和 Rerank 5 现已登陆 OpenRouter。开发者只需使用单一的 API 密钥，就能通过几行 Python 代码 轻松构建高效的检索增强生成（RAG）工作流。
zh.full_summary:
工作原理
搭建现代 RAG（检索增强生成）系统通常需要组合多种工具，但现在 OpenRouter 将 Cohere 最新的两款检索主力模型整合在了一起。系统利用 Embed 5 Pro 以最高质量构建可搜索的文档索引，同时用 Embed 5 Fast 以极低延迟处理实时查询，由于它们共享嵌入空间，因此能在保证速度的同时维持出色的准确率。
精准重排
通过向量相似度初步筛选出候选文档后，Rerank 5 会介入对结果进行重新打分和过滤。由于其相关性评分在不同查询和领域之间高度一致，开发者只需设定单一阈值，就能在内容送达大模型之前精准剔除无关上下文。
实际优势
这种统一的方案大大简化了开发流程并降低了基础设施的维护成本。从向量生成到最终的对话响应，所有环节都通过同一接口完成，让开发者能够极其轻松地更换模型或扩展企业级文档检索业务。

en.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
en.summary: Confucius4-R2T2 is a streaming speech recognition model that achieves near-offline accuracy with low latency by post-training on Longest Stable Prefix labels without changing model architecture.
en.full_summary: This paper presents Confucius4-R2T2, a stable-prefix streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) model designed for real-time applications such as voice agents and simultaneous translators. Traditional streaming ASR systems often revise partial transcripts as more context arrives, which wastes compute and causes errors in downstream agents. To solve this, the authors introduce the Longest Stable Prefix (LSP) concept, proving it to be monotone, consistent with full-audio outputs, and maximal. By post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio using LSP supervision while freezing the audio encoder and projector, R2T2 produces append-only, stable text without architectural modifications. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that R2T2 approaches base-model full-context quality with low emission lag and strong cross-lingual generalization. The code and model weights are open-sourced.

zh.title: Confucius4-R2T2：用于真正实时转录的稳定前缀流式语音识别模型
zh.summary: Confucius4-R2T2是一个流式语音识别模型，通过在最长稳定前缀标签上进行后训练，在不改变模型架构的情况下以低延迟实现了接近离线的准确率。
zh.full_summary: 本文介绍了Confucius4-R2T2，这是一种专为语音代理和同声传译等实时应用设计的稳定前缀流式自动语音识别（ASR）模型。传统的流式ASR系统在获取更多上下文时经常修正部分转录文本，这会浪费计算资源并导致下游代理出错。为了解决这一问题，作者引入了最长稳定前缀（LSP）概念，证明了其单调性、与完整音频输出的一致性以及极大性。通过在冻结音频编码器和投影仪的同时，利用1500小时的中英文音频及LSP监督对Qwen3-ASR-1.7B进行后训练，R2T2在无需修改架构的情况下生成只增不改的稳定文本。广泛的评估表明，R2T2在保持低发射延迟和强大跨语言泛化能力的同时，接近了基础模型的全上下文识别质量。相关代码和模型权重已开源。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Systems
en.summary: Training AI agents often hits walls when their execution environments fail. Instead of searching for one perfect setup, researchers introduced Harness-S, a method that uses a pool of specialized sibling environments to rescue failed attempts and teach the agent better problem-solving skills. When tested on multiple complex tasks, this approach significantly outperforms traditional training methods and helps agents perform much better on their original systems.
en.full_summary:
Background
Training AI agents to handle complex coding and tool-use tasks usually relies on a fixed execution harness. However, every tweak to these scaffolds tends to fix some errors while breaking others, making it hard to find a universally superior setup.
Details
To solve this, researchers developed Harness-S. It builds a pool of specialized sibling harnesses along different repair directions. When the primary base harness fails completely on a task, the system routes the problem to these auxiliary harnesses to generate successful trajectories. An Adaptive Harness Router uses behavior profiles and LLM voting to select the best helper harness. The agent then learns from these rescued runs, effectively absorbing the helper behaviors into its own core policy.
Impact
Experiments across benchmarks like AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench show that the resulting policy greatly outperforms standard reinforcement learning methods when returning to the original base system. This proves that diverse execution environments can successfully transfer useful skills directly into the AI model itself.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用兄弟执行环境训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 训练AI智能体时，经常会遇到执行环境报错卡壳的情况。研究人员没有去寻找一个完美的配置，而是推出了 Harness-S 方法，通过一组特殊的“兄弟环境”来拯救失败的尝试，并把这些经验 教给AI模型。在多个复杂任务测试中，这种方法的效果远超传统训练，能让AI在原本的系统里 发挥得更出色。
zh.full_summary:
背景
训练AI智能体处理复杂的编程和工具调用任务时，通常依赖于固定的执行环境。然而，对这些脚手架的每一次修改往往是“修好了这个错误，却弄坏了那个错误”，很难找到一个完美的通用配置。
细节
为了解决这个问题，研究人员开发了 Harness-S 方法。它沿着不同的修复方向构建了一组特殊的“兄弟环境”。当主基础环境在任务中彻底失败时，系统会将问题分流到这些辅助环境中，从而生成成功的执行轨迹。一个 自适应路由器 会通过行为画像和大模型投票来选择最合适的帮手。随后，AI会从这些被“救活”的运行轨迹中学习，将这些有用的应对技巧吸收进自己的核心策略中。
影响
在 AppWorld、SWE-Gym 和 DBBench 等多个基准测试上的实验表明，训练后的AI模型在返回原本的基准环境时，其性能 大幅超越 了传统的强化学习方法。这证明了多样化的执行环境能够成功地将 宝贵经验内化 到AI模型本身当中。
